source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("Uber drivers" OR "ride-hailing drivers" OR "app-based drivers") AND (work OR labour OR labor)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("Uber drivers" OR "ride-hailing drivers" OR "app-based drivers") AND (work OR labour OR labor),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("Uber drivers" OR "app-based drivers" OR "ride-hailing drivers") AND ("labor" OR "labour" OR "work"))
